fields.description: By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
fields.name: Lion King

fields.description: Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
fields.name: Pecking Order

fields.description: Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
fields.name: Pig-Headed
relatedpages_links: Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest

fields.description: It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
fields.name: Personal Nightmare

fields.description: It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
fields.name: Thick-Skinned

fields.description: Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
fields.name: Chequered Teddy

fields.description: Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
fields.name: Blacknailed

fields.description: Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
fields.name: Slugging Around

fields.description: It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
fields.name: Knock on Wood

fields.description: This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
fields.name: Fried Shrimp

fields.description: What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
fields.name: Out of the Stone Age

fields.description: A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
fields.name: Stuntman

fields.description: Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
fields.name: Gear Up

fields.description: Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
fields.name: Bearbaiting

fields.description: 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
fields.name: Lucky Horseshoe

fields.description: By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
fields.name: Swamp Beast

fields.description: Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
fields.name: Spin-Off

fields.description: Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
fields.name: Icy Glare

fields.description: You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
fields.name: Cartography 101

fields.description: Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
fields.name: Lost Palace Raider

fields.description: It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
fields.name: The More the Merrier

fields.description: You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
fields.name: Rift Warrior

fields.description: You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! – You weren't there for the hat only after all?
fields.name: Hat Hunter

fields.description: You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
fields.name: Ogre Chef

fields.description: You opposed man-eating ogres and clumsy clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
fields.name: The Call of the Wild

fields.description: You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world — at least for a while.
fields.name: Ender of the End

fields.description: After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
fields.name: Vortex Tamer

fields.description: Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
fields.name: Rhino Rider

fields.description: You could not resist the taste of the forbidden fruit. Since you don't feel changed at all, it couldn't have been that bad after all. Or could it?
fields.name: Forbidden Fruit (Achievement)

fields.description: Perhaps with so much acquired knowledge, never meant for you, you know even when to stop! Time will tell whether this knowledge will do more harm or good.
fields.name: Forbidden Knowledge

fields.description: You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
fields.name: Treasure Hunter

fields.description: You met the legendary First Dragon and survived. That's a reason to celebrate for sure.
fields.name: Reason to Celebrate

fields.description: You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
fields.name: Toothfairy Assistant

fields.description: Teasing fairies is fun. They leave behind such pretty clouds of glittering dust when chased. Just hope they don't get you back for it.
fields.name: Fairy Teasing

fields.description: You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
fields.name: Corruption Contained

fields.description: You have fully unlocked 10 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
fields.name: Little Adventure

fields.description: You have fully unlocked 100 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
fields.name: Little Big Adventure

fields.description: You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
fields.name: Contender

fields.description: You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
fields.name: Serious Contender

fields.description: You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
fields.name: Skilled Hunter

fields.description: You have fully unlocked 100 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
fields.name: Master Hunter

fields.description: You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
fields.name: Hunting Permit

fields.description: The Curse of the Full Moon transforms harmless citizens into feral beasts. But with your help, Edron and Cormaya are safe - fairly.
fields.name: Over the Moon

fields.description: You defeated the Count of the Core and destroyed his lava pump!
fields.name: His Days are Counted

fields.description: You defeated the Duke of the Depths and destroyed his lava pump!
fields.name: Duked It Out

fields.description: You defeated the Baron from Below and destroyed his lava pump!
fields.name: Buried the Baron

fields.description: The Baron from Below, Duke of the Depths and the Count of the Core are no more!
fields.name: Death in the Depths

fields.description: You took the heat and defeated the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla!
fields.name: Scourge of Scarabs

fields.description: Exploring the depths of Tibia can be a dangerous task. Surprisingly, some crude wood planks, rusty nails and a tinged pot can offer a sufficient protection against the creatures lurking in the deep.
fields.name: Cobbled and Patched

fields.description: Putting this candle stump on your new mount was kind of a waiting game. You're even tempted to call it whack-a-mole. But in the end you found a loyal companion for your journeys into the depths.
fields.name: Up the Molehill

fields.description: You truly are the grand master of verbal debate! Now going forth and putting this wisdom to good use in everyday life... is probably debatable.
fields.name: Master Debater
spoiler_links: The Grand Master of Verbal Debate

fields.description: You asked Captain Charles to take a shortcut quite a few times. Now you are all too familiar with desert islands all over Tibia.
fields.name: High and Dry

fields.description: Tall trees, deep forests and and the beauty of Ab'Dendriel - you really know every corner of the elven lands now.
fields.name: Elven Woods

fields.description: Ancient battlefields, amazons and the glory of Carlin - you really know every corner of Queen Eloise's realm now.
fields.name: Long Live the Queen

fields.description: Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
fields.name: Stronghold of Edron

fields.description: Vast mines, an orc fortress and the magnificence of Kazordoon - you really know every corner of North-Eastern Mainland now.
fields.name: Dwarven Mines (Achievement)

fields.description: Old temples, a meadowy countryside and the splendour of Thais - you really know every corner of King Tibianus' realm now.
fields.name: All Hail the King

fields.description: Damp swamps, a dry desert and the opulence of Venore - you really know every corner of Eastern Mainland now.
fields.name: Jewel in the Swamp

fields.description: A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
fields.name: The Ogre Steppe

fields.description: Lush meadows, colourful fairies and sentient stones - you really know every corner of Feyrist now.
fields.name: Realms of Dreams

fields.description: You have combed the desert and searched the pyramid city of Ankrahmun.
fields.name: Mummy's Dearest

fields.description: You journeyed through Darashia and the sea of sand around it, while fighting the perils of the desert.
fields.name: Daraman's Footsteps

fields.description: You have searched Port Hope and the jungle that thoroughly, that you are up to adoption by a friendly ape family.
fields.name: King of the Jungle

fields.description: You've braved the perils of Yalahar and learned of its gloomy shadows of long gone greatness.
fields.name: Ancient Splendor

fields.description: A pirate's haven and a burglar's hideout. You found your way around Liberty Bay and its surroundings - land, ho!
fields.name: Liberty Bay Watch

fields.description: You have expelled the fog of the unknown from the islands of Svargrond. Maybe not as first, but that's not what matters in the end.
fields.name: Race to the Pole

fields.description: From the southern steppe through the Dragonblaze Mountains and the Muggy Plains to the forbidden city of Razachai - you really know every corner of Zao now.
fields.name: Lizard Kingdom

fields.description: Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
fields.name: Trip to the Beach

fields.description: Glooth is the substance that powers a whole continent and all its weird inhabitants, workshops and factories. You travelled this strange smorgasbord of curiosities in its entirety - just in time for tea.
fields.name: Glooth Punk

fields.description: A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
fields.name: Twisted Dreams

fields.description: Though you couldn't prevent the theft of the godbreaker knowledge, you still managed to fight off the invasion of the library and to kill the scourge of oblivion, a powerful servant of the enemy.
fields.name: Library Liberator

fields.description: You checked out a strange temple deep in the jungles of Tiquanda. Spectulus was right, it was indeed overrun by strange fish-men you now call Deathlings.
fields.name: Spectulation

fields.description: You defeated Grand Master Oberon and the remnants of the Order of the Falcon, no matter the odds.
fields.name: Millennial Falcon

fields.description: You passion for reading was somewhat diminished by biting books and aggressive quills. But this flying specimen proved to be a loyal companion. Never judge a book by its cover!
fields.name: Bibliomaniac

fields.description: Wielding dangerous knowledge as well as the sword is your expertise. You have proven yourself versatile in all manner of situations.
fields.name: Battle Mage

fields.description: As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
fields.name: Widely Travelled

fields.description: You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
fields.name: Running the Rift

fields.description: Not only did you master the battlefield as a mage, you were also induced to the most inner secrets of the art of magical warfare and prevailed.
fields.name: Exalted Battle Mage

fields.description: Wisely contributing your resources to areas, you pushed creatures to maximum effect, allowing improved respawn for everyone! Well done!
fields.name: Areas of Effect

fields.description: You figured out the right order of spells in the buried cathedral, how enchanting!
fields.name: Tied the Knot

fields.description: You found the Seven Keys to unlock ... no, not the seven seas. But at least seven doors in the realm of dreams.
fields.name: Keeper of the 7 Keys

fields.description: You became an acquaintance of the courts of dreams and acquired the right to display your new status and title of 'dream warrior'.
fields.name: Dream Warrior

fields.description: Your lantern was too bewitching for a hibernal moth. It couldn't withstand and follows you, the bearer of the lantern, now.
fields.name: Moth Whisperer

fields.description: You caught a lacewing moth with your lantern. It will follow you in companionship as the bearer of the lantern will be its guide through the darkness now.
fields.name: Lacewing Catcher

fields.description: This sleigh is not driven by magic but pushed by a percht. Hopefully you two get along well together...!
fields.name: No Horse Open Sleigh

fields.description: But can you truly be one of them?
fields.name: Raider in the Dark

fields.description: You are the slayer of the ancient nightmare beast and prevented the nightmare to spread its madness.
fields.name: Dream Catcher (Achievement)

fields.description: You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Summer Court.
fields.name: Champion of Summer

fields.description: You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Winter Court.
fields.name: Champion of Winter

fields.description: You literally put everything in that cauldron except lilac and gooseberries.
fields.name: Bewitcher

fields.description: Unmasking spies, killing demons, discovering omens, solving puzzles and fighting ogres, manticores and feral sphinxes. - Nobody said it was easy to become a gryphon rider.
fields.name: Gryphon Rider

fields.description: Granted, you didn't carve those lifelike animal figurines yourself. But helping a medusa to find proper objects and even watching her using her petrifying gaze is almost as rewarding.
fields.name: Sculptor Apprentice

fields.description: You made sure that the balance of sun and sea is preserved in Kilmaresh. The Golden City of Issavi won't forget your favour.
fields.name: Sun and Sea

fields.description: You ended the regn of Scarlett Etzel. All-seeing yet blind, ever powerful yet ultimately helpless, she never got a second chance to truly see. Or has she...
fields.name: A Study in Scarlett

fields.description: What draws things to other dimensions, one wonders. You read the almanac at just the right spot to end up... where, of all places? That is the problem with dimensional travel: you will never know. Or you have always known. And everything in between.
fields.name: Avid Spectral Reader

fields.description: You did the hippo population of Kilmaresh a great favour. A well-fed hippo is a happy hippo.
fields.name: Hippofoddermus

fields.description: You defeated the Lich Knights and became the hand of the Inquisition, allowed to wear their special garb.
fields.name: Inquisition's Hand

fields.description: Mythical creatures, forgotten catacombs and the Golden City - you really know every corner of Kilmaresh now.
fields.name: The Empire's Glory

fields.description: Your special garb, solely awarded to a dedicated Hand of the Inquisition, is now complete.
fields.name: Inquisition's Arm
relatedpages_links: Hand of the Inquisition Outfits Quest

fields.description: You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
fields.name: Traditionalist

fields.description: Riding a traditional beer barrel from the Orcsoberfest is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.
fields.name: Do a Barrel Roll!

fields.description: The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its traditional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"
fields.name: Orcsoberfest Welcome

fields.description: You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of greed and obsession.
fields.name: Prospectre

fields.description: You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
fields.name: Nothing but Hot Air

fields.description: And so it begins!
fields.name: Verminbane

fields.description: Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!
fields.name: Monsterhunter

fields.description: Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
fields.name: Taskmaster

fields.description: Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
fields.name: Mainstreet Nightmare

fields.description: A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
fields.name: Falconer

fields.description: Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
fields.name: Steppe Elegance

fields.description: Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
fields.name: Beyonder

fields.description: If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
fields.name: Drama in Darama

fields.description: Made acquaintance with three brothers Fitz.
fields.name: Malefitz
relatedpages_links: The Order of the Lion Quest

fields.description: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
fields.name: Lionheart
spoiler_links: The Order of the Lion Quest

fields.description: You were burdened with all this soul crushing negativity and still beat Malice, Hatred, Spite, Cruelty and Greed just to help one repentant soul. But as the saying goes: No soul is left behind!
fields.name: Soul Mender

fields.description: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
fields.name: You Got Horse Power

fields.description: You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
fields.name: Unleash the Beast

fields.description: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
fields.name: Well Roared, Lion!

fields.description: When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!
fields.name: Honorary Rascoohan

fields.description: Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
fields.name: Release the Kraken

fields.description: You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.
fields.name: Pied Piper

fields.description: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
fields.name: Woodcarver
relatedpages_links: The Order of the Lion Quest

fields.description: Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.
fields.name: Bounacean Chivalry

fields.description: Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
fields.name: Knowledge Raider (Achievement)

fields.description: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
fields.name: Citizen of Issavi

fields.description: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
fields.name: King's Council

fields.description: Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
fields.name: Hot on the Trail

fields.description: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
fields.name: Shell We Take a Ride

fields.description: This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
fields.name: Phantastic!

fields.description: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
fields.name: Some Like It Hot

fields.description: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
fields.name: First Achievement

fields.description: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
fields.name: Sharp Dressed

fields.description: This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
fields.name: Engine Driver

fields.description: You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
fields.name: Friendly Fire

fields.description: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
fields.name: Wedding Planner

fields.description: You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
fields.name: Beaver Away

fields.description: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
fields.name: Snake Pit

fields.description: For some it can't be hazardous enough.
fields.name: Royalty of Hazard

fields.description: Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
fields.name: Measuring the World

fields.description: Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your ripptor.
fields.name: Ripp-Ripp Hooray!

fields.description: Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
fields.name: Warrior of the Iks

fields.description: You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours
fields.name: Mutagenius

fields.description: Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.
fields.name: Strangest Thing

fields.description: You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
fields.name: Fully Decayed

fields.description: Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
fields.name: Like Fox and Mouse

fields.description: Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
fields.name: The Spirit of Purity

fields.description: You unveiled the secret plot of the Mitmah who stole away an entire civilisation for their own entertainment. Let the death of their outpost vanguard be an eternal lesson to them.
fields.name: Museum Goer

fields.description: Proving your true worth to a mystic creature like the jaguar, king of the hunt, granted you not only respect but also its heart.
fields.name: Mystic Predator

fields.description: You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
fields.name: The Rule of Raccool

fields.description: You freed the captive forest fury from the Corym Black Market. A friend in need is a friend indeed!
fields.name: A Friend in Need

fields.description: Things you do... for science.
fields.name: Holzkopf

fields.description: ... on a pegasus, to a land of honey and milk. With this beautiful flying steed you certainly can.
fields.name: I Wanna Fly Away

fields.description: Traversing the innards of Podzilla was a conquest in and by itself, thanks to Two Lips you are now one with the plant biosphere as you stride its many intertwined trails.
fields.name: The Rootwalker

fields.description: The [[Soulpit]] resonates as the spirit of your final foe shatters under your might.
fields.name: Soul Crusher

fields.description: The transcendence to a higher state of mind and existence in order to achieve inner peace has been amplified by various means throghout Medudri history. Among them a manifold of potions with varying potence - it seems some of them actually work...
fields.name: Inner Peace

fields.description: Riding such an ancient beast is certainly a good and harmless idea.
fields.name: Fiend Rider

fields.description: No living fiends were hurt to achieve this outfit.
fields.name: Fiend Slayer

fields.description: On the shoulders of demons, you tore through veils of venomous corruption. Demonic essences made you an unstoppable force but take care to also foster your human side.
fields.name: Tear the Toxic Veil
relatedpages_links: No Rest for the Wicked Quest
spoiler_links: No Rest for the Wicked Quest

fields.description: You followed the Three-Fold Path as did generations of Merudri before you. Carry the legacy, culture and hope of the Merudri proudly into this realm, the hearts of its people and beyond.
fields.name: Hope of the Merudri
relatedpages_links: The Way of the Monk Quest
spoiler_links: The Way of the Monk Quest

fields.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your katar into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
fields.name: Umbral Redeemer

fields.description: Pray it never finds its way back to its original stable with you still riding.
fields.name: Hell Rider

fields.description: You never can tell, who's boss here.
fields.name: Alpha Rider

fields.description: The first step to greatness has been done.
fields.name: The First of Many

fields.description: Your expertise in weaponry reaches new heights.
fields.name: A Well-Honed Arsenal

fields.description: Feared by your enemies, admired by many - your reputation in weapon mastery precedes you.
fields.name: Arsenal of War

fields.description: Surely, this will prove useful in the future... right?
fields.name: The Forbidden Build

fields.description: No matter your command, this beast is all ears!
fields.name: Bat Person

fields.description: Joran and Yvette have brought the colours back to the world, and you have freed it from the monsters of this story. The world of books is now yours.
fields.name: Illuminator

fields.description: The pen is mightier than the sword. In a way, yes, you have had this experience. You have seen with your own eyes what the power of words can do, the written word, to be precise.
fields.name: Power of Words

fields.description: Your stash is cleared, your bestiary completed but the grind has only just begun.
fields.name: Errand Runner

fields.description: Whether it's clearing cellars from rats or delivering quara eyes with a smile, you get the job done.
fields.name: Workhorse

fields.description: You don't just read the bulletin board, you live on it.
fields.name: Taskaholic

fields.description: From rotworms in caves to dragons in the sky, no creature is safe from your overzealous swatting.
fields.name: Pest Control

fields.description: Apparently not all chests are the same. Some have a life of their own and if you think about it... how do so many of them actually refill every day? Well, you're one step closer to revealing this secret
fields.name: Mimic (Achievement)

fields.description: You freed the remnants of the Order of the Stag on the Isle of Ada from a warlock's yoke. An evil puppet master who lead many Stags against their own brethren. Eldoran the Ambitious, heir of Eldoran Etzel, Cadwgan's bastard son, is forever grateful.
fields.name: Bastard
relatedpages_links: The Order of the Stag Quest
spoiler_links: The Order of the Stag Quest

fields.description: That has been a close call ...
fields.name: Razor's Edge

fields.description: Many letters have been written by knights of the Order of the Stag. Some personal while others were simply a mistake. We often ask ourselves what happened to these once corresponding souls, we hope for the best but have to fear for the worst.
fields.name: Lost Letters

fields.description: Modifying Brewmaster Bhaan's Raubritter Lager with a hint of Night Harpy, you received a potent remedy against their vicious attacks. Drinking so much of it however, you wonder what other side effects it has as you stare at the moon... mesmerised...
fields.name: Stagmeister

fields.description: You've learned the way of the wilderness: its patience, its fury, its grace. As a feral trapper, you embody them all.
fields.name: Feral Trapper

fields.description: Somebody will be terribly sad about your actions! Imagine how much time it took to build all those castles ....
fields.name: Castle Crasher

fields.description: You have spent 70.000.000 gold overall to fund the Great Expedition. Congratulations for helping to make this dream come true!
fields.name: Stakeholder

fields.description: You have your principles and that is also reflected in your vote for the crew of the Great Expedition.
fields.name: Principled

fields.description: The hungry ram devoured the whole bunch of turnips in a single bite, then looked at you as if it was ready for more. Make sure to keep it well fed along the way.
fields.name: A reliable Friend

fields.description: You are quite curious about these echoes.
fields.name: Echo Initiate

fields.description: The echoes are beginning to infiltrate your dreams.
fields.name: Echo Hunter

fields.description: Walking past an echo is no option. You're already addicted.
fields.name: Echo Walker

fields.description: Exploring the echoes was only the beginning. Now, you conquer them.
fields.name: Echo Conqueror

fields.description: Psss psss psss ...
fields.name: Purrfectly Addicted

fields.description: Swift and silent, the jaracal now runs at your side.
fields.name: Six Steps Ahead

fields.description: On top of a cloud, the sun is always shining.
fields.name: Radiant Nimbus

fields.description: You answered the call of the moon goddess and thwarted the asuri's plans. Yet the echoes will linger, and the whisper of the moonsilver is now a part of Marapur.
fields.name: Amati's Echo
spoiler_links: Shards of a Broken Moon Quest

fields.description: You stared into the Light without blinking. Foolish or enlightened... who can tell?
fields.name: Enlightened, Indeed

fields.description: Being the captain is as much a privilege to some as it is a burden to others. You took the helm by doing everything to make the Great Expedition succeed. Steer clear of trouble, stay your course and a bright future will always be ahead of you!
fields.name: Aye-aye, Captain!

fields.description: As an avid collector you managed to complete a full set of rubber ducks during the Great Expedition and traded it for a unique noble bath tub! Given you will acquire even more ducks in the future, this is the proper way to launch them!
fields.name: Rubber Ducking

fields.description: Your outstanding work towards the launch of the Great Expedition turned out well for you. You decided it's time to take a break and the Landsailer for a spin! May you always have wind in your sails and a hand-width of even ground under your wheels!
fields.name: Sail Away!
